memories.memory: I support increasing public funding for museums, galleries, and working artists, even if it means paying a little more in local taxes.
In the last national election, I voted for a centre-left party because I preferred its plans for public healthcare and pensions.
I am strongly opposed to nationalist politics and believe European countries should cooperate more closely rather than retreat behind their borders.
I was raised Catholic, but I no longer believe in organized religion and consider myself agnostic.
I believe artistic achievement should be judged by the quality and persistence of the work, not by an artist's popularity or social connections.
I support stricter climate regulations on heavy industry, although I think governments should compensate older workers who lose jobs during the transition.
My brother and I regularly argue about whether our country should keep its monarchy; I favor replacing it with an elected head of state.
